avis.titre: Wonderful texture and even better smoothing results
avis.texte: gifted by drunkelephant. Drunk Elephant's glycolic night serum has quickly become a staple in my evening skincare routine. My skin has been loving the thoughtfully chosen ingredients, and the gentle chemical exfoliation has given me great results without any irritation, peeling, or sensitivity. I always wake up with skin that looks brighter, smoother, and noticeably more radiant when I use it the night before. The formula is clear, lightweight, and absorbs quickly, making it easy to layer with the rest of my skincare. It never pills and leaves my skin feeling comfortable rather than sticky or heavy. After several weeks of consistent use, I've noticed my skin tone and texture look more even, my pores appear less noticeable, and my skin feels incredibly soft. I've even seen an improvement in the appearance of fine lines when my face is at rest. I love following it with Drunk Elephant's Lala Retro moisturizer, and together they leave my skin feeling nourished and refreshed by morning. Since this is an exfoliating acid treatment, I make sure to wear sunscreen every day while using it to help protect my skin. If you're new to glycolic acid or tend to be sensitive, I'd recommend starting with every other night and increasing frequency as your skin adjusts. Overall, this serum has been a wonderful addition to my routine, and I'll definitely keep repurchasing it because I love both how it feels and the results I've seen.
